label: sparse late-original/delimiter feature in sequences containing g (no clean rule)
explanation: Very sparse (0.03% of steps). It fires only at original-phase steps t>=3 and at the <DEL> step (75% and 20% of mass); it almost never fires in the copy phase and never at t<3. Activity is enriched when g appeared earlier (especially two steps back, 11x lift), when the first token is t, q or a digit 0-2 (t: 10x), when the previous input is v/g/m/n, and when the current input is x/a/e/1/i/t or <DEL>. The rate rises at the last original position of long sequences. These are weak conjunctive tendencies, not a rule: the best conjunction scores dev precision 0.036, recall 0.41, F1 0.066. Most likely it reads a distributed hidden-state direction. Magnitude is fairly flat (median 0.12, max 0.28), and no variable I checked clearly modulates it.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=t (+4.37), orig2=g (+4.34), orig0=2 (+3.50), orig1=g (+3.31), orig3=g (+3.21), orig1=0 (+3.08). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-4.59), phase=2 (-3.17), prev_tok=0 (-3.14), prev2_tok=0 (-2.76).
